description: Generate a disposable email inbox for testing signups, OTP verification, magic links, and password resets. Instant and local — no network request. Use the returned address wherever an email is required, then call wait_for_email to read what arrives. Free tier: 30-minute retention, no signup needed. With a key from zerodrop.dev/keys in ZERODROP_API_KEY, the name starts with the key's prefix and only that key can read the inbox.

prefix.description: Optional prefix for the inbox name, e.g. your app or test name

name: generate_inbox
